items.question: Within how many hours must an employer inform the UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) of a workplace injury or death?
items.fact: Employer must report workplace injury or death to MoHRE within 48 hours

items.question: What is the minimum compensation in AED paid to heirs when a worker dies from a work injury under UAE employment law?
items.fact: Death compensation for work injury is at least AED 18,000
